intro: Wayward Weapons is an early training task in the Valley of Trials, issued by the overseer Gornek. With young warriors arriving in droves to serve the Horde, armaments are running thin. To prove their discipline and support the encampment, recruits scour the scrubland to salvage gear abandoned by less capable predecessors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Throm'ka, adventurer. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Were you able to collect the training weapons I requested?
Thank you for returning these weapons, friend. I will get to work repairing them for the next wave of recruits.
